message.content: IllidanStormrage proposed several ideas to involve the community in supporting local businesses. He suggested that community members could participate in regular community gardening days, which would not only help with maintaining the garden but also allow everyone to learn about caring for the plants together. Additionally, he encouraged the community to engage in activities such as the upcoming bake sale, which supports a local charity. These initiatives aim to foster a sense of community ownership and encourage participation in supporting local businesses.
